title: Leave-one-out error from one ridge fit
brief: Build the hat matrix and its diagonal, the leverages, and use them to compute the leave-one-out error of ridge regression without refitting.
hints: hat_matrix: X @ np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X + lam * np.eye(d)) @ X.T, with d = X.shape[1]. Keep the lam * np.eye(d) term.
leverages is the diagonal of the hat matrix: np.diag(hat_matrix(X, lam)).
loo_linear_smoother: r = y - H @ y, then divide by 1 - leverages, square, and average.
